_comment: HM abilities (slot hm): used from the HM button, recharge after rules hm/cooldown seconds. Each works on any map; the map part (clearing grass, swimming, pushing boulders, breaking walls) is a bonus. The special parts are in brawler.gd use_hm().

hm_cut.name: Cut
hm_cut.desc: Long slash through everything in front: bleeds, clears tall grass and reveals whoever was hiding in it

hm_fly.name: Fly
hm_fly.desc: Leap 5 m over walls and water (untouchable on the way up); the landing slows enemies next to you

hm_surf.name: Surf
hm_surf.desc: A wide wave that rolls 6 m, pushing enemies back and slowing them; next to water you ride it and swim for a few seconds

hm_strength.name: Strength
hm_strength.desc: Grab the nearest enemy in front and hurl it 4 m: into a wall or rock it's stunned and takes extra damage. Knocks the ball loose; still shoves boulders

hm_flash.name: Flash
hm_flash.desc: Blind and reveal enemies around you, and get a burst of speed

hm_rock_smash.name: Rock Smash
hm_rock_smash.desc: A punch that lowers Defense for 4 s, and smashes any wall or rock next to you
